name: v0.7.6
body:
## What's Changed
### Features

* fix: show top-level log record EventName in logs view by @tridev-tej in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/498

### Bug Fixes

* fix(tui): show unset metric fields as not set and stop the summary panic by @Detoy in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/499
* fix(tui): show span-level dropped counts in the span detail by @momolly1024 in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/500

### Others

* [Automated] Update Nix Flake by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/484
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 13 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/485
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 21 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/487
* chore: remove redundant depandabot config for tuiexporter by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/488
* chore: remove legacy lint tool dependencies by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/489
* ci: split Go build cache keys per job by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/490
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 21 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/491
* chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/sys from 0.48.0 to 0.49.0 in the dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/492
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 21 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/493
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 20 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/494
* chore(deps): bump the dependencies group with 21 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/501
* ci: cap golangci-lint memory and keep the main lint cache alive by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/503
* docs: add CONTRIBUTING.md with issue claim and assignment flow by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/504
* [Automated] Update otel-tui/tuiexporter version by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/505
* ci: extend goreleaser timeout to 60m in the release workflow by @ymtdzzz in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/508

## New Contributors
* @tridev-tej made their first contribution in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/498
* @momolly1024 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/500
* @Detoy made their first contribution in https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/pull/499

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ymtdzzz/otel-tui/compare/v0.7.5...v0.7.6
